content: हृष् €1 €4 <ab>P.</ab> (हर्षति, हृष्यति, हृष्ट or हृषित) .²1 To be delighted or rejoiced, be pleased or glad, to exult, rejoice; अद्वितीयं रुचात्मानं मत्वा किं चन्द्र हृष्यसि <ls>Bv. 2. 54</ls>; <ls>Mv. 7. 13</ls>. .²2 To bristle or stand erect, stand on end (as the hair of the body); सुखवेदनाहृषितरोमकूपया <ls>Śi. 13. 13</ls>; हृषितास्तनूरुहाः <ls>Dk.</ls>; हृष्यन्ति रोमकूपानि <ls>Mb.</ls> .²3 To become erect (said of other things, {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} the penis). .²4 To lie, tell a lie. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (हर्षयति-ते) To please, delight, fill with pleasure.
